title: directory-structure diagram: core emitter (Mermaid/DOT/SVG) + CLI `graph --scope tree` — real dir/file names
description:
User request 1 of the B5 batch (asked 2026-10-17): create a feature that shows the directory structure using graphs/diagrams, using the actual names, representing the directory.

Sibling cards: B5-02 (GUI drag/pan/zoom for diagram canvases), B5-03 (flow/graph interactivity), B5-04 (VS Code-like shell), B5-05 (GUI Diagrams to Directory panel).
Owner seat: CORE/exp + PROD graph (one seat, because the CLI and the GUI export both read this emitter).

Deliverable: an additive core emitter that renders the directory tree of `Index::files` (and nothing invented), exported like the other diagrams.
  * Nodes = the repository root, then every directory that actually contains indexed files, then files as leaves. Labels are the real names (`src`, `diagrams`, `control.rs`), not synthetic ids; a file label may carry `name (LOC)` because the emitter has `FileEntry.lines`.
  * Structure edges: plain parent-child containment, visually distinct (e.g. plain lines rather than arrows); mark entrypoints (`FileEntry.is_entrypoint`) with a distinct shape/color in DOT/SVG and a text marker in Mermaid.
  * Optional (flag on the emitter, defaults off): dashed `Import` edges aggregated between directories, so the same shape can also show cross-directory traffic.
  * Wire it: CLI `repowalk graph --scope tree [--format mermaid|dot|svg] <path>` (mermaid default). The same emitter must be reusable by the GUI Export menu (another card adds that entry; you only expose the variant).

Constraints: no contract change (add the `Diagram::Directory` variant; do not rename existing variants), no new dependencies, emitters stay pure functions over `(&Index, &Analysis)` like the sibling scopes, output deterministic (BTreeMap/sorted everywhere). Template/escaping rules must match the existing emitters (Mermaid ids/names escaping, DOT quoting).

Verify: on `fixtures/sample` (with root, a.rs, b.rs, main.rs, model.rs, tool.py, util.rs) the mermaid output contains one node per real name and correct parent-child shape; on this repo the root plus `crates`, `crates/core`, `crates/core/src` appear with real names and the file leaves carry LOC. Determinism: two runs byte-identical. Unknown formats error as today.
GATES: cargo fmt/clippy/test on core + cli. Never commit/push; hand to the integrator by message.

evidence.summary: Diagram::Directory { imports: bool } added after Modules (no variant renamed/reordered). New pure emitter crates/core/src/export/directory.rs builds, from Index::files ONLY: root named with the repo basename, real directories (ancestor chain only), real file leaves with '(N LOC)' labels; entrypoints get a star marker + Oval/stadium/ellipse shape. Containment edges are plain open lines (new util::Arrow::Open -> mermaid '---', dot arrowhead=none, svg line without marker-end); optional flag renders dashed aggregated Import edges between directories of two indexed files (never invents nodes for unmappable targets like 'crate::other'). CLI: GraphScope::Tree + clap possible-value help; --symbol rejected like types/modules/call (diagram_for_scope helper). CLI artifacts::load canonicalizes the root so passing '.' still names the repo 'repowalk' (store/cache semantics untouched; a cache-root contract test forced that revert).
